status_note: Project hibernated 2020-03-31; archive of past observations remains accessible
instrument: Arecibo Observatory (1420 MHz hydrogen line, 2.5 MHz bandwidth, retired 2020)
format: BOINC work-unit .dat (~365 KB each, 107s recording @ 0.6 Hz bins)

quota_decision.reason: work-unit files distributed via BOINC volunteer-compute network, not bulk-downloadable from public HTTP. Direct re-analysis requires BOINC client; deferred to X3 sweep stage.

x3_use_plan: use SETI@home best-candidate list (Top 6, e.g. SHGb02+14a 2004) coordinates as Φ-scan targets; raw work-unit playback deferred to dedicated BOINC pod

best_candidates.name: SHGb02+14a
best_candidates.note: between Pisces/Aries; ruled inconclusive after re-observation
